purpose: Candidate evidence inventory; calibration and holdout roles are intentionally unassigned.

protocol.event_time_zero: Use an independently documented ignition trigger or event time. Never choose an offset by minimizing model error or aligning measured and simulated peaks. If independent time zero is unavailable, absolute timing metrics are ineligible; a source-documented shape-only alignment must be labeled exploratory and cannot score ignition delay.
protocol.pressure_preprocessing: Convert only with the registered source units. Do not smooth, filter, fit gain, or fit offset. Apply baseline subtraction only from a documented calibration or pre-event interval; otherwise absolute-amplitude and baseline-normalized metrics are ineligible.
protocol.simulation_alignment: Interpolate simulation pressure linearly at native measurement timestamps over the common time overlap only. Do not extrapolate or resample/smooth the experimental trace.
protocol.windows: Register per-case startup, plateau, and tail-off windows using measurement metadata and the measured trace only, before inspecting model predictions. Do not assume universal numeric windows across motors. If a window cannot be defended, mark its metrics ineligible.

pressure_metrics.rmse_mpa: sqrt(mean((P_sim(t_i) - P_exp(t_i))^2)) over a registered valid window
pressure_metrics.mae_mpa: mean(abs(P_sim(t_i) - P_exp(t_i))) over a registered valid window
pressure_metrics.bias_mpa: mean(P_sim(t_i) - P_exp(t_i)) over a registered valid window
pressure_metrics.normalized_rmse: rmse_mpa / (P_plateau_exp - P_baseline_exp), only when baseline and plateau are independently identifiable and the pressure channel is suitable for amplitude comparison
pressure_metrics.startup: Report peak pressure and time-from-independent-t0 in the registered startup window; report 10-90% rise time only when baseline and plateau are defensible.
pressure_metrics.peak_to_plateau_ratio: (P_peak - P_baseline) / (P_plateau - P_baseline), only with a documented linear pressure channel and defensible baseline/plateau.

protocol.thrust_metrics: When force calibration is documented, report RMSE, MAE, bias, and trapezoidal total impulse over the registered common interval separately from pressure metrics.
protocol.aggregation: Report each firing separately. If aggregating, give each motor equal weight rather than pooling all samples; do not introduce a composite score or segment weights without predeclaring them.
protocol.fit_holdout_split: Unassigned; when eligible cases exist, split by whole motor or independent firing, never by samples from the same firing.
protocol.legacy_scoring_note: The baseline runner's manual time offsets and the LHS peak-alignment windows/segment weights are existing overlay or calibration mechanisms, not validation rules. Register their anchors and windows under this protocol before using them for validation.
protocol.acceptance: No empirical acceptance threshold is set by this protocol. The provisional 2% numerical screen is not an experimental validation criterion.

source_workbook.csv_numeric_match: All 346 time and pressure pairs match the CSV to 9 decimal places; maximum absolute pressure difference is 5.0e-10 MPa.

source_only_observations.qualification: The peak and samples are trace facts. The approximately 8.77 MPa plateau has no registered source-only window; the derived 1.015 peak/plateau ratio is descriptive only and does not establish absence of an ignition spike.

legacy_plotting_overlay.qualification: The extra zero-time/zero-pressure point has no documented relationship to the source measurement, trigger, or baseline. Keep these arrays for legacy plot overlays only, not protocol v0.1 scoring.

legacy_lhs_alignment.qualification: Historical calibration/overlay settings, not independent event-time evidence or validation rules.

high_resolution_source.tail_coverage: The extracted series ends at 8.153 s flight time while the workbook's raw DAQ continues later; its last pressure is still above the workbook-derived baseline. Tail-off window remains unregistered.
